decision: Original controls repaired; one remaining P2 termination false-success edge must be corrected before accepting this evidence adapter.

findings.title: Always downgrade status for a later exceptional termination
findings.detail: terminate only calls invalidate when termination_reason is None. After terminate(stdin quit, ended), a later terminate(exception, unavailable) leaves case_status ended and invalid_reasons empty. The run loop continues processing all keys in a selected batch after control sets stopping, so a subsequent key can raise into the exception handler. Cleanup then has exception metadata but product_bound_claim_allowed=true and return code 0.
findings.reproducer: Exact-source socket-free method invocation: Case.__new__, initialize state, terminate("stdin quit","ended"), set exception metadata, terminate("exception","unavailable"). Observed ended, [], claim_allowed true, return formula 0. Receipt reason-repair-late-exception-counterexample.json.
findings.fix: Preserve the first termination_reason if useful, but apply invalidate for every non-ended termination independently of whether a reason already exists; ensure exception always produces unavailable/false/exit 2. Add a late-exception-after-quit control.

verified: All nine receipt objects exactly match the manifest and their raw JSONL cleanup records.
Three raw pre-fix controls show the reported reason mislabels.
Final connection budget, stdin overflow, early injected exception, fifth request and watchdog controls carry false claim allowance, invalid/unavailable state and exit 2.
Fifth-request raw log reports all five complete fixture responses and accepted=closed=5.
Normal raw log has accepted=closed=17, five full fixture transfers, no invalid reasons, case_status ended; the inspected smoke harness asserts process exit 0.
No source/product change, server, browser, Cargo, renderer, or GPU execution. Only direct terminate method calls and receipt audit.
remaining_limits: One actual Web app receiving twelve GUI Opens remains pending; current controls are direct HTTP adapter evidence only.
